constraints_details.constraints_layer_description: ART4 Article 4 Direction - Boroughwide HMO Restriction

PLAHIS Planning Application Reference: DM2025/01552 - Address: 137 Stafford RoadWallingtonSM6 9BN - Proposal: Change of use of first and second floors from Class C3 (residential) to Class C4 (four room House In Multiple Occupation) and provision of cycle storage to the rear of the property. - Status: GTD - Decision: GTD - Date Decision Issued: 02-MAR-26

application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Prior to the commencement of development, an Energy Statement incorporating 'as-designed' Reduced Data Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing which demonstrates how the proposed House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) will apply the Mayor's energy hierarchy (use less energy, supply energy efficiently and use renewable energy) to minimise carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions over and above the Part L 2021 baseline and deliver at least a 10% reduction in overall operational emissions (including regulated and unregulated emissions) through on-site renewable energy generation. Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to first occupation, written confirmation that the approved on-site renewable energy technologies have been implemented as part of the development as built must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing together with 'as-built' Reduced Data Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputsdemonstrating that the required emissions reductions have been achieved. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the commencement of the development (excluding demolition works), full details of the secure cycle storage facilities shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority which shall show their positioning within the site, the size and materials of the enclosure and the means of access. The approved details shall be implemented on site prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter permanently retained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the development provides an adequate level of cycle parking facilities and to encourage sustainable modes of transport, in accordance with Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018. This condition is required to be pre-commencement as cycle storage needs to be designed into the scheme at a early stage of the construction process and respect the materials and design of the development.
description: Application to clear condition 3 (as-designed energy statement), 4 (renewable energy technologies) and 5 (secure cycle storage) of approved application DM2025/01552.
